notes: All 4 photos were legible menus: 1.jpg is a printed take-out menu covering the full menu, 2-4.jpg are three overlapping shots of the same in-store menu board. Merged and de-duplicated. Salads/Bowls are priced by a chosen protein add-on rather than a fixed per-dish price, so those items are listed without price; the Kids combo (choose any two items for one flat price) and pure drinks were skipped.
